sources.title: Models overview - Claude Platform Docs
sources.snippet: Choosing a model If you're unsure which model to use, start with Claude Opus 5 for complex agentic coding and enterprise work. For workloads that need the highest available capability, use Claude Fable 5. All current Claude models support text and image input, text output, multilingual capabilities, and vision.
